subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — GlacierTech (multi-region / SLA points)
messages:
From: Amanda Su <amanda.su@glaciertech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@glaciertech.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — GlacierTech / Redwood

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Thanks for the connect yesterday. As discussed, GlacierTech is ready to begin contracting for the pilot (order form + MSA). Attaching our draft SOW and a party sheet to help speed intake. A few things to flag up front so we can keep the first redline pass tight: 

- Multi-region hosting: we need an explicit clause that guarantees EU data residency for a subset of customer data (logs and backups excluded).
- SLA: target 99.9% monthly uptime for the pilot, with service credits tied to request latency tiers.
- Signatory mapping: procurement will sign order forms under $250k; anything larger needs VP Legal + VP Product.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report and encryption at-rest details — procurement will request these during review.

Could you confirm which Redwood template you want us to redline against (your standard MSA or the 'privacy-forward' variant)? Also confirm an internal point of contact for SOC2 evidence delivery.

Attachments: GlacierTech-SOW_v1.docx, Exhibit-A_party-sheet.xlsx

Best,
Amanda
Amanda Su
Strategic Sourcing
GlacierTech
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Su <amanda.su@glaciertech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — GlacierTech / Redwood

Amanda — thanks, received. Looping in Kimberly (legal ops) and Marissa (contracts) to kick off intake and scope the first redline pass. Quick answers and asks below: 

- Template: please redline against our canonical Redwood_MSA_Template_v3 (link below). We will produce a privacy-forward variant only if GlacierTech requires additional residency guarantees beyond what we can commit in an exhibit.
- SOC2: Kimberly will own evidence intake; Kimberly, Amanda — can you share a secure transfer mechanism (SFTP or shared Drive link) for the most recent report?
- SLA language: we prefer to keep primary uptime obligations in the Order Form and use service credit tiers rather than liquidated damages. If GlacierTech insists on a specific credits table, please propose the target numbers in your redline.
- Signatory mapping: Marissa — I’ll need your recommended signer threshold for EU customers and for mixed-revenue deals.

Action items: 
1) Kimberly: confirm preferred evidence intake method and whether you need an NDA before we exchange SOC2.
2) Marissa: draft initial signer matrix and where to place signing authority in the Order Form (exhibit or main body).
3) Amanda/Procurement: send the final SOW and any internal purchasing docs that define approval thresholds.

Links: https://app.redwood.ai/templates/msatemplate/v3  (Redwood canonical MSA)
HubSpot: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/GLAC-2026-042

Thanks — aiming to get first redlines to you by EOD Thursday PT.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Amanda Su <amanda.su@glaciertech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@glaciertech.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — GlacierTech / Redwood

Thanks Irene — we'll redline against your canonical template. 

On quick clarifications: VP Legal for GlacierTech is Amanda Lin (amanda.lin@glaciertech.com) and will appear on any countersign > $250k. For SOC2 transfer, procurement can share via a secure Box folder — I'll send the invite to Kimberly's redwood email once you confirm.

One more ask: because the pilot spans EU and US customers, is Redwood able to include a short SLA exhibit that lists regional latency targets per region? If so, we'll sketch baseline latency tiers for the first pass.

Attaching: updated SOW with pilot acceptance criteria (GlacierTech-SOW_v1.docx).

Amanda
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Su <amanda.su@glaciertech.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — GlacierTech / Redwood

Amanda — appreciate the speed. Commercial note for planning: pilot order form target value is $180k (FY26 Q3). If GlacierTech anticipates broader production expansion we'll need to align on a 12-month committed bandwidth and discuss a reserved capacity pricing lane. 

Timeline ask: can we get your procurement and legal redlines within 72 hours of our first redline? We want to keep the signing window under 3 weeks if possible.

I'll coordinate with finance for a draft order-form price schedule once Marissa posts the initial signer thresholds.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — GlacierTech / Redwood

Thanks all — quick intake summary and next steps from contracts ops: 

1) Template: Redwood_MSA_Template_v3 attached for our baseline. We'll accept redlines in track changes; please mark any residency-specific asks as Exhibit A items.
2) Signers: per Irene's ask, attached is a provisional signer-mapping CSV. For the pilot ($180k) procurement signature is sufficient; anything > $250k will route to VP Legal + VP Product.
3) SLA exhibit: we can include a short regional latency table as Exhibit B. Amanda — please send the proposed latency tiers by EOD tomorrow so legal can map service-credit bands.
4) SOC2: Kimberly — once you confirm Box invite I'll provide a temporary NDAs link if GlacierTech prefers.
5) Target dates: First redline delivered by Redwood: Thu 2026-05-21 EOD PT. GlacierTech counter by Sun 2026-05-24. Signed pilot by Fri 2026-06-04.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx; Signer-Mapping_GlacierTech.csv
